definition.simple: When something changes its place or position as time passes.
definition.academic: The change in position of an object with respect to its surroundings in a given interval of time.

examples: The second hand of a clock

common_misconceptions: People sometimes think if an object moves at a constant speed, it has no motion.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student if they are in motion while sitting in a moving train, relative to a passenger next to them vs. relative to the platform.
